general_information.Syllabus Name: Digital Marketing Strategy_Chiến lược marketing số
general_information.Learning-Teaching Method: Project based learning, Research-based learning, Social Constructivism, Presentation, Blended Learning, Group work
general_information.Description: Description: This course is based on the Coursera Specialization "Digital Marketing," offering a comprehensive exploration of the dynamics and global aspects of digital marketing. Students will delve into how the Digital Revolution has impacted marketing and gain insights into the core processes of planning and executing a digital marketing campaign. Additionally, the course integrates the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to equip students with essential skills for market data collection, consumer behavior analysis, and effective digital marketing strategy development. By the end of the course, students will be able to select the most suitable marketing channels for various products and design impactful AI-powered digital campaigns. *Teaching Method: This blended-learning course combines self-paced online study with collaborative in-class activities. Students are required to review videos, slides, and readings on Coursera before class. During class sessions, they will review key content and engage with peers and instructors to reinforce and apply their knowledge.
general_information.StudentTasks: Student Tasks: - Access the learning materials on Coursera for self-study purposes - Attend at least 80% of contact hours to be eligible for the final assessment - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by the instructor after class - Apply AI tools responsibly and ethically in assigned exercises - Use their laptop in class only for learning purposes - Access http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand how digital tools are changing the nature of marketing in basic
Explain clearly how digital tools allow consumers to take a more active role in product development, promotion, placement, and pricing activities
Obtain a new set of concepts, tools, and stories to enhance your digital marketing efforts effectively
Understand the strategic impacts of digital media and information technologies on communication and marketing
Apply the concepts, tools, and knowledge provided to formulate a digital marketing plan
Shows self-reliance when working independently and collaboratively
Demonstrate ethical awareness and reflection in business context
Understand how to apply AI technologies to collect information and create effective digital marketing strategies
